summary_en: Interim dividend of 16 yen per share for fiscal year ending March 2027, including 3 yen commemorative dividend. Total dividend amount is 765 million yen with an effective date of December 10, 2026. Commemorative component marks the company's acquisition of Fujimaru Sangyo as a wholly owned subsidiary in March 2026.
title_en: Notice regarding dividend of surplus (interim dividend and commemorative dividend for the 76th fiscal period)
translation_en_brief:
Tsurumi Manufacturing announced an interim dividend of 16 yen per share for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, with a record date of September 30, 2026 and an effective date of December 10, 2026. The total dividend amount is 765 million yen, funded from retained earnings. Of the per-share dividend, 3 yen represents a commemorative component.

The commemorative dividend was declared to mark the company's acquisition of Fujimaru Sangyo Co., Ltd. as a wholly owned subsidiary in March 2026. Fujimaru specializes in rental of large submersible pumps, temporary and permanent drainage facility construction, and pump maintenance services. The acquisition strengthens the company's capacity to respond to growing demand in social infrastructure sectors, particularly disaster management related to heavy rainfall, typhoons, and linear precipitation patterns.

The company stated that its basic capital policy is to ensure stable dividend continuity while securing sufficient cash flow for long-term business expansion and value creation. The company continues a progressive dividend policy with the aim of expanding total dividends through profit growth. Prior year's interim dividend was 26 yen per share (with 2 yen commemorative component) as of September 30, 2025, which was before the company executed a 2-for-1 stock split effective October 1, 2025.
